        // vpkstuff patch: tracks the m_refAnimIncludeModels names currently on the
        // load stack so a cyclic include graph can't recurse forever. Thread-static
        // because each LoadFileCompiled returns a FRESH Model instance (so no
        // per-instance cache breaks the cycle) and glTF/animation export is
        // single-threaded (GltfModelExporter.RunExport's IsExporting guard).
        [ThreadStatic] private static HashSet<string>? _animIncludeStack;

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets animations referenced from other models.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="fileLoader">The file loader to use.</param>
        /// <returns>Enumerable of animations.</returns>
        public IEnumerable<Animation> GetReferencedAnimations(IFileLoader fileLoader)
        {
            var refAnimModels = Data.GetArray<string>("m_refAnimIncludeModels");
            if (refAnimModels == null || refAnimModels.Length == 0)
            {
                return [];
            }

            // vpkstuff patch: cycle guard. Without it, a model whose
            // m_refAnimIncludeModels resolves back to itself (e.g. a bare upload
            // whose include sibling is missing and the loader's filename fallback
            // returns the model file) recurses GetReferencedAnimations ->
            // GetEmbeddedAnimationsWithSkeleton -> GetAllAnimations -> here across
            // fresh instances until the stack overflows (uncatchable process crash).
            // Skip any include already being processed on this stack.
            var stack = _animIncludeStack ??= new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            var allAnims = new List<Animation>();
            foreach (var modelName in refAnimModels)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(modelName) || !stack.Add(modelName))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                try
                {
                    using var resource = fileLoader.LoadFileCompiled(modelName);
                    if (resource?.DataBlock is not Model model)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    var anims = GetEmbeddedAnimationsWithSkeleton(fileLoader, Skeleton, model);
                    allAnims.AddRange(anims);
                }
                finally
                {
                    stack.Remove(modelName);
                }
            }

            return allAnims;
        }
